title: SessionHistoryPageParams
description: Params for session.historyPage: one page of a session's live history, read as the emulator holds it (nocx-zg3k3.10.3). The rows do not ride this result — they travel the binary data plane on the screen frame's own carrier, keyed by the pageId the result mints (AD-1, ADR-0066, ADR-0073).

before.description: The exclusive upper bound of the page, in the session's absolute history row numbering — the numbering every result carries in start/end/floor, where a row's number is fixed for its lifetime and only the floor beneath it moves. null asks for the head: the newest retained rows. A cursor below the retained floor is not an error; the answer is the empty interval at the cursor with the floor stated.

limit.description: The most rows one page may carry. The bound is the page's own: a page is one helper round trip and one carrier document, so it is small by construction, and paging is how a caller reaches deeper history.
